title: Place - a composite tool that stamps an image onto the current entry
description: Third composite front end, redesigned with the user 2026-08-21 (brainstorm on MPI-562). placeComp sits in the Composite toolbar group. Its panel is one MpiMediaSlot, a Remove Background toggle and Apply. The slot fills three ways: dropping an image file on the History workspace (which also auto-selects the tool - this is the MPI-377 bug, absorbed), clicking the empty slot to open MpiMediaPicker, or right-click Paste off the existing _compositeImage buffer. A gizmo moves/scales/rotates the placed image over the selected entry; Apply flattens it into ONE new history entry. Video mode keeps its chip behaviour untouched. Full design: brief.md. ABSORBS MPI-377; umbrella MPI-562 closed as no longer needed.
acceptance: A third composite tool placeComp sits in the Composite toolbar group beside mask comp and paint comp, and is registered in _COMPOSITE_TOOLS so teardown, the PromptBox gate and _viewerModeFor() all cover it

The panel is exactly three things: one MpiMediaSlot labelled "Image to place", a Remove Background toggle, and Apply. No Cancel - MpiToolOptionsComposite has none, and a rail switch already discards the preview

The slot fills from three gestures: a file dropped on the History workspace, a click on the empty slot opening MpiMediaPicker (project media plus its upload card), and right-click Paste off the _compositeImage buffer Send to Composite already seeds
Dropping an image on the History workspace in IMAGE mode selects placeComp and fills its slot - it no longer only stages a PromptBox chip (the MPI-377 bug)
Video mode is untouched: while the video prompt tool is active a drop still becomes a chip, and start/end-frame drops still unlock the frame-driven i2v ops
A multi-file drop fills the slot from the first file and raises a toast naming the rest as ignored - no file is ever dropped silently

Remove Background runs the existing removeBackground universal op (BiRefNet, an engineAsset) on the slot image, and is reversible: toggling it off restores the original slot pixels with no second dispatch
A gizmo with the shape gizmo's handle set moves, scales and rotates the placed image over the selected entry; SHIFT locks aspect ratio and ALT scales about the centre, same as MpiToolOptionsShapes
The placed image keeps its own alpha - a background-removed PNG shows the entry through its transparent pixels, with no mask involved
Apply writes ONE new history entry at the base entry's full resolution; both sources are untouched
Leaving the tool restores the single-entry canvas and writes nothing to disk (the preview contract) - discardPreview is EXTENDED, never the call site
Undo / redo covers a placement the same way a shape commit is covered
Apply is dead-gated, not silent: an empty slot renders Apply disabled with a hint, never a click that swallows itself

docs/composite.md is updated, in particular its "a filled slot has one origin, not two" line - this card widens it deliberately, because a drop and the picker are different ORIGINS rather than a redundant gesture
